newsitem.title: CHINA: About 20 dead in southeast China building collapse.
newsitem.headline: About 20 dead in southeast China building collapse.

text.p: About 20 people were killed and more than 40 injured when an apartment building collapsed in China's southeastern Fujian province, officials said on Thursday.
"About 20 people were killed," said an official from the city of Putian where the disaster occurred on Tuesday evening.
At least 40 people had been taken to hospital after the four-storey building collapsed and five or six people were still missing, hospital and city government officials said by telephone.
"The structure of the building may have been faulty," the city official said, adding that the cause was still under investigation.
Other officials said rescue operations were still under way.

A Hong Kong television station earlier said that at least 25 people died and 30 were missing when the hostel housing more than 2,000 workers collapsed. It said the hostel belonged to a Hong Kong-based electronics firm.
